user.title: Mantel Link
user.description: Link Home Assistant to Mantel. Mantel's address is {https}, or {http} only for the Mantel App on this machine ({app_url}). Then a pairing code from Mantel Settings, Connections, Mantel in Home Assistant, or a Mantel Service credential (Mantel Settings, Service Accounts).

reconfigure.title: Mantel Link
reconfigure.description: A new address or credential. Leave the credential empty to keep the saved one.

hassio_confirm.title: Mantel
hassio_confirm.description: Link Home Assistant to Mantel, found running as the {addon} App? Mantel's wall tablets and actions then show in Home Assistant.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Mantel
zeroconf_confirm.description: Mantel was found on your network at {url}. To link it, make a pairing code in Mantel Settings (Connections, Mantel in Home Assistant, Make a Pairing Code) and enter it here.

error.url_insecure: Use {https}. Plain {http} is only for Mantel on this machine (the Mantel App).
error.url_not_internal: That name doesn't lead to this machine's App network, so {http} isn't allowed. Use {https}.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Mantel at that address.
error.mantel_too_old: That Mantel is older than Mantel Link. Update Mantel first.
error.another_mantel: That address is a different Mantel. Remove Mantel Link and add it again to change Mantel.
error.code_or_token: Enter a pairing code (or a Service credential).
error.invalid_code: Mantel did not accept that pairing code. Make a new one in Mantel Settings.
error.rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
error.not_mantel: That address answered, but it couldn't prove it is the Mantel that made the code.
error.wrong_address: Mantel says that isn't its address, so something else may be answering for it. Enter Mantel's own address, as Mantel Settings shows it, and make a new pairing code if this one has run out.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Mantel Link is already set up.
abort.another_mantel_linked: Home Assistant is already linked to another Mantel.
abort.invalid_discovery: That announcement didn't describe a Mantel.

set_black_screen.name: Set black screen
set_black_screen.description: Turns a wall tablet's black screen on or off and sets the brightness it comes back to.

brightness.name: Brightness
brightness.description: The brightness to come back to (0-255).

show_popup.name: Show pop-up
show_popup.description: Opens one of Mantel's pop-ups on its screens.

close_popup.name: Close pop-up
close_popup.description: Closes one of Mantel's pop-ups on its screens.

notify.name: Notify
notify.description: Shows a banner on Mantel's screens.

important.name: Important
important.description: Shown even in Do Not Disturb.

music_play.name: Play music
music_play.description: Plays a playlist in the rooms named (Mantel's music).

music_transfer.name: Move music
music_transfer.description: Moves what one player plays to the rooms named.

music_stop.name: Stop music
music_stop.description: Stops the music in the rooms named, or everywhere.

music_transport.name: Music controls
music_transport.description: Play/pause, next, previous, stop or volume on one player.

music_play_media.name: Play this
music_play_media.description: Plays one item on one player.

clean_areas.name: Clean areas
clean_areas.description: Sends the vacuums that reach them to clean the areas named (Mantel's Clean Areas).

pause_automation.name: Pause an automation
pause_automation.description: Turns an automation off until a time (default: midnight), then on again.

resume_automation.name: Resume an automation
resume_automation.description: Turns a paused automation on again now.
